name: Nakano Hayato
source:
[url=/c33314]Shirakawa Chihiro[/url]'s boyfriend, who is Nanami's younger sister.

He is extremely crude and inappropriate, both in his appearance and his behavior, and resembles a small-time thug.

He is unemployed, has a gambling habit, and frequently hangs around with unsavory associates.

He occasionally visits Shuichi's home together with Chihiro and casually joins the family for meals, acting as though this is perfectly natural.

Although he is dating Chihiro, he privately regards the relationship as little more than casual entertainment.

If an opportunity presented itself, he even entertains the outrageous idea of getting involved with her older sister, Nanami, as well...

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
